channel.title: inception/mercury-3 — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases: 2–8 November 2026
item.description: Hy4, LongCat 2.5 and Inkling 2 Small expand hosted access. New image and video APIs bring separate billing meters, while local releases make license and memory checks part of the cost decision.

item.title: Mercury 3: removed from tape
item.description: The listing was removed from the price tape. This does not establish provider retirement; check its model card and official sources.

item.title: AI model releases: 19–25 October 2026
item.description: A completed-week review, updated through the Kimi and MiniMax notes published on 26 October. New APIs, public weights, specialist models, and the price and access changes that affect a deployment.
